detail.longDescription: I (finally) set up #federation on my #Ghost blog. This means you can get more but rarer words from me by following @ michael . First post, very meta, is about how I #shitcoded #MySQL + #S3 support into Ghost's #ActivityPub and got it running on my own #kubernetes cluster. RE: https://westergaard.site/2026/10/ghost-with-self-hosted-activitypub/
